title: list-emails Tool Schema
description: MCP tool schema for listing emails with optional folder filtering

count.description: Number of emails to retrieve (default: 10, max: 50)

folder.description: Folder to retrieve emails from. Supported values: inbox (default), spam, junk, sent, drafts, trash, deleted, all. Case-insensitive.

examples.description: List 10 most recent inbox emails (default behavior)
List all emails from all folders

emails.description: Array of email messages from the specified folder

receivedDateTime.description: ISO 8601 datetime when email was received

count.description: Number of emails returned in this response

errors.message: Invalid folder: {folder}. Supported folders: inbox, spam, junk, sent, drafts, trash, deleted, all
errors.description: Returned when user specifies an unsupported folder name

errors.message: Folder '{folder}' not found. Supported folders: inbox, spam, junk, sent, drafts, trash, deleted, all
errors.description: Returned when Microsoft Graph API cannot find the specified folder

errors.message: Access denied to folder '{folder}'. Check mailbox permissions.
errors.description: Returned when user lacks permission to access the folder

errors.message: Not authenticated. Please run authenticate tool.
errors.description: Returned when user has not completed OAuth authentication

notes.breaking_changes: Default behavior changed from returning all folders to returning inbox only. Users needing the old behavior can specify folder='all'.
notes.backward_compatibility: Existing calls without folder parameter will now return inbox-only emails (improved default). To get all folders, explicitly set folder='all'.
notes.case_sensitivity: Folder names are case-insensitive. 'Inbox', 'INBOX', and 'inbox' are all valid.
notes.pagination: Pagination behavior ($top parameter) is preserved across all folders.
notes.sorting: Emails are always sorted by receivedDateTime in descending order (most recent first).
